business_segments.name: Lithography Systems
business_segments.description: ASML provides advanced lithography systems used in semiconductor manufacturing, including DUV and EUV technologies.

business_segments.name: Metrology and Inspection

products.name: DUV Lithography
products.description: A lithography technology that uses deep ultraviolet (DUV) light.

products.name: EUV Lithography
products.description: A lithography technology that uses extreme ultraviolet (EUV) light with a wavelength of 13.5 nm.

products.name: TWINSCAN Platform
products.description: ASML’s unique lithography system platform with two complete wafer stages for higher accuracy and throughput.

products.name: YieldStar
products.description: ASML’s optical diffraction-based wafer metrology platform.

technologies.name: EUV Lithography
technologies.description: Uses extreme ultraviolet light for advanced semiconductor manufacturing.

technologies.description: A dual-stage lithography system for increased throughput and accuracy.
technologies.differentiator: Allows simultaneous wafer mapping and exposure.

competitor_evidence.text: Applied Materials, Inc. is the leader in the materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every semiconductor in the world.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Applied Materials, Inc. is the leader in the materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every semiconductor in the world.

competitor_evidence.text: The Semiconductor Systems segment designs, develops, manufactures and sells a wide range of equipment used to fabricate semiconductor chips.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Our Semiconductor Systems segment designs, develops, manufactures and sells a wide range of equipment used to fabricate semiconductor chips, also referred to as integrated circuits (ICs).

competitor_evidence.text: The Semiconductor Systems segment consists of the semiconductor capital equipment industry’s most comprehensive portfolio of products used in the chip making process.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: The Semiconductor Systems segment consists of the semiconductor capital equipment industry’s most comprehensive portfolio of products used in the chip making process.

competitor_evidence.text: Our products address steps across materials engineering, process control and advanced packaging, including the conversion of patterns into device structures, transistor and interconnect fabrication, metrology, inspection and review, and packaging technologies for connecting finished IC die.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Our products address steps across materials engineering, process control and advanced packaging, including the conversion of patterns into device structures, transistor and interconnect fabrication, metrology, inspection and review, and packaging technologies for connecting finished IC die.

competitor_evidence.text: Our patterning systems and technologies address challenges resulting from shrinking pattern dimensions and the growing complexity in vertical stacking found in today’s most advanced semiconductor devices.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Our patterning systems and technologies address challenges resulting from shrinking pattern dimensions and the growing complexity in vertical stacking found in today’s most advanced semiconductor devices.

competitor_evidence.text: Our transistor and interconnect products and technologies enable continued power and performance improvements of 3D transistors.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Our transistor and interconnect products and technologies enable continued power and performance improvements of 3D transistors.

competitor_evidence.text: Our process control systems employ optical and eBeam technologies that allow customers to inspect and review critical semiconductor architectures throughout the manufacturing process.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Our process control systems employ optical and eBeam technologies that allow customers to inspect and review critical semiconductor architectures throughout the manufacturing process.

competitor_evidence.text: ASML's advanced packaging systems use materials engineering expertise to connect multiple chips together through heterogeneous integration.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Our advanced packaging systems use our materials engineering expertise to allow customers to connect multiple chips together through heterogeneous integration.

competitor_evidence.text: ASML's Semiconductor Systems sales are to customers that serve the foundry, logic, and other markets.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Our Semiconductor Systems sales are to customers that serve the following markets: foundry, logic and other; dynamic random access memory (DRAM); and flash memory (NAND).

competitor_evidence.text: ASML serves customers producing on the most advanced technology nodes, defined as 7 nanometers and smaller.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Leading-edge represents customers that are producing on the most advanced technology nodes, defined as 7 nanometers and smaller.

competitor_evidence.text: ASML serves non-leading edge technology nodes that serve markets such as internet of things, communications, automotive, power and sensors.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Non-leading edge technology nodes serve markets such as internet of things, communications, automotive, power and sensors.

competitor_evidence.text: Lam Research addresses processes for back-end wafer-level packaging (WLP), which is an alternative to traditional wire bonding and can offer a smaller form factor, increased interconnect speed and bandwidth, and lower power consumption, among other benefits.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: We also address processes for back-end wafer-level packaging (“WLP”), which is an alternative to traditional wire bonding and can offer a smaller form factor, increased interconnect speed and bandwidth, and lower power consumption, among other benefits.

competitor_evidence.text: Lam Research offers advanced packaging solutions that support fan-out panel-level packaging, a process in which chips or chiplets are cut from a large format substrate sheet several times the size of a traditional silicon wafer, which increases yield and reduces waste.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: We offer advanced packaging solutions that support fan-out panel-level packaging, a process in which chips or chiplets are cut from a large format substrate sheet several times the size of a traditional silicon wafer, which increases yield and reduces waste.

competitor_evidence.text: Lam Research provides products and services to maximize installed equipment performance, predictability, and operational efficiency.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Our Customer Support Business Group (“CSBG”) provides products and services to maximize installed equipment performance, predictability, and operational efficiency.

competitor_evidence.text: Lam Research offers a broad range of services to deliver value throughout the lifecycle of their equipment, including customer service, spares, upgrades, and new and refurbished non-leading edge products in their deposition, etch, and clean markets.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: We offer a broad range of services to deliver value throughout the lifecycle of our equipment, including customer service, spares, upgrades, and new and refurbished non-leading edge products in our deposition, etch, and clean markets.

competitor_evidence.text: Lam Research introduces many technical advances in their newest products that are also available as upgrades, providing customers with a cost-effective strategy for extending the performance and capabilities of their existing wafer fabrication lines.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Many of the technical advances that we introduce in our newest products are also available as upgrades, which provide customers with a cost-effective strategy for extending the performance and capabilities of their existing wafer fabrication lines.

competitor_evidence.text: Lam Research's spares product line offers running cost optimization programs and focuses on product life extension to help customers increase the return on their capital purchases.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Our spares product line offers running cost optimization programs and focuses on product life extension to help customers increase the return on their capital purchases.

competitor_evidence.text: Within CSBG, Lam Research's Reliant® product line offers new and refurbished non-leading edge products in deposition, etch and clean markets for those applications that do not require the most advanced wafer processing capability.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Additionally, within CSBG, our Reliant® product line offers new and refurbished non-leading edge products in deposition, etch and clean markets for those applications that do not require the most advanced wafer processing capability.

competitor_evidence.text: Lam Research provides Electrochemical Deposition (ECD) for metal films as part of their product offerings.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Deposition Metal Films Electrochemical Deposition (“ECD”) (Copper & Other) SABRE® family

competitor_evidence.text: Lam Research offers Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) and Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) for dielectric films.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Dielectric Films Plasma-enhanced CVD (“PECVD”) ALD VECTOR® family Striker® family

competitor_evidence.text: Lam Research provides Reactive Ion Etch for conductor etch as part of their product offerings.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Etch Conductor Etch Reactive Ion Etch Kiyo® family Versys® Metal family Akara® family

competitor_evidence.text: Lam Research offers Deep Reactive Ion Etch for through-silicon via (TSV) etch.
competitor_evidence.excerpt: Through-silicon Via (“TSV”) Etch Deep Reactive Ion Etch Syndion® family

sources.title: ASML HOLDING NV XBRL company facts

evidence.text: DUV is a lithography technology that uses deep ultraviolet (DUV) light.
evidence.excerpt: A lithography technology that uses deep ultraviolet (DUV) light.

evidence.text: EUV is a lithography technology that uses extreme ultraviolet (EUV) light with a wavelength of 13.5 nm.
evidence.excerpt: A lithography technology that uses extreme ultraviolet (EUV) light with a wavelength of 13.5 nm – this is the cutting-edge of lithography and provides the highest resolution possible.

evidence.text: EXE is ASML’s second TWINSCAN platform for EUV lithography, also referred to as EUV 0.55 NA or High NA EUV.
evidence.excerpt: ASML’s second TWINSCAN platform for EUV lithography, also referred to as EUV 0.55 NA or High NA EUV.

evidence.text: A lithography technique uses a pool of ultrapure water between the lens and the wafer to increase the lens’s numerical aperture.
evidence.excerpt: A lithography technique that uses a pool of ultrapure water between the lens and the wafer to increase the lens’s numerical aperture (ability to collect and focus light).

evidence.text: This improves both the resolution and depth of focus for the lithography system.
evidence.excerpt: This improves both the resolution and depth of focus for the lithography system.

evidence.text: Lithography, or photolithography, is the process in microchip manufacturing that uses light to pattern parts on a silicon wafer.
evidence.excerpt: Lithography, or photolithography, is the process in microchip manufacturing that uses light to pattern parts on a silicon wafer.

evidence.text: ASML’s first TWINSCAN platform for EUV lithography provides 13 nm resolution to support advanced Logic and Memory chip production.
evidence.excerpt: NXE ASML’s first TWINSCAN platform for EUV lithography with a numerical aperture of 0.33 that provides 13 nm resolution to support advanced Logic and Memory chip production; also referred to as EUV 0.33 NA.

evidence.text: TWINSCAN is ASML’s unique lithography system platform, with two complete wafer stages to allow one wafer to be mapped while another is being exposed, thereby enabling higher accuracy and throughput.
evidence.excerpt: TWINSCAN ASML’s unique lithography system platform, with two complete wafer stages to allow one wafer to be mapped while another is being exposed, thereby enabling higher accuracy and throughput.

evidence.text: Wafer inspection is the process of locating and analyzing individual chip defects on a wafer.
evidence.excerpt: Wafer inspection The process of locating and analyzing individual chip defects on a wafer.

evidence.text: Wafer metrology is the process of measuring the quality of patterns on a wafer.
evidence.excerpt: Wafer metrology The process of measuring the quality of patterns on a wafer.

evidence.text: The shorter the wavelength of light used in a lithography system, the smaller the features the system can resolve.
evidence.excerpt: The shorter the wavelength of light used in a lithography system, the smaller the features the system can resolve.

evidence.text: YieldStar is ASML’s optical diffraction-based wafer metrology platform.
evidence.excerpt: YieldStar ASML’s optical diffraction-based wafer metrology platform.
